text_blocks.snippet: For travel to Mexico in 2025, U.S. citizens generally need a valid U.S. passport and, depending on the mode of entry, potentially a Forma Migratoria Múltiple (FMM), also known as a tourist card. While the FMM is no longer required at many major airports, it is still needed for land crossings and stays exceeding a certain duration, according to travel publications. The time granted for your stay is now at the discretion of immigration officials at the port of entry.
